non_goals: Not a proof about all authorization systems, actors, actions, contents, logs, or HoTT representations.
Not a FHIR deployment, access-control implementation, NIST compliance proof, retention proof, or cryptographic append-only log.
Not a proof that HoTT has no reality-relative paradox or that the full T1 task is complete.
proof_assistant_version:
Agda version 2.8.0-3d04bac
Built with flags (cabal -f)
 - optimise-heavily: extra optimisations
 - use-xdg-data-home: install and locate data files under $XDG_DATA_HOME/agda/$AGDA_VERSION by default instead of the location defined by Cabal
scope: Cubical Agda fixed capability/interface positive control for H₀: one permitted update internally appends an actor/action event, an authorized reader observes the two-event log, outsider update/read capability types are empty, and content restoration is distinct from full-state return. No FHIR, deployment, NIST enforcement, retention, WORM, cryptographic logging, HPT merge/replay, or general representation theorem.
theory_variant: Cubical Agda with native Path and higher inductive types
